name: Shinsengumi - Bakumatsu Genshikou
source:
An ordinary school girl experienced time slip to the Edo period while on a school trip. And since she resembled captain of Shinsengumi unit Okita Souji, she just pretended to be him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-november-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个普通的女学生在修学旅行中穿越到了江户时代。由于她长得很像新选组的队长冲田总司，于是她就假扮成了他。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-november-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
